stage: Durable local Pack snapshot staging and restart recovery
coverage: Real Cosign verified private candidate persists all payload and proof bytes.
Fresh Node process restores original validation report and content without private trust authority.
Cancellation and pre-publication fsync failure remove only current temporary snapshot.
Post-rename parent fsync failure preserves complete uncertain snapshot.
Metadata commitment, payload and proof replacement are rejected.
Insecure roots, symlinks, hardlinks and traversal are rejected.
limitations: 64 MiB payload/proof snapshot and 2 MiB metadata; deployment-owned durable local filesystem only.
Filesystem calls are checked at I/O boundaries, not forcibly interrupted in kernel.
Installation transaction, deploymentVersion CAS, impact evidence, Enable/Registry and orphan GC remain unimplemented.
Recovery only checks stored integrity; current authority, trust, revocation, expiration and installation must be checked separately.
